stories.title: Add Spring Security + JWT dependencies to backend
stories.description: As a developer, I need the backend to have Spring Security and JWT libraries configured so I can protect write endpoints.

stories.title: Create JWT utility service
stories.description: As a developer, I need a JWT utility class to generate and validate tokens so auth can be stateless.

stories.title: Create authentication endpoints
stories.description: As the admin, I want to log in with my credentials and receive a JWT so I can make authenticated requests.

stories.title: Create JWT authentication filter and Security configuration
stories.description: As a developer, I need Spring Security configured to protect all write endpoints while keeping GET endpoints public.

stories.title: Add displayOrder field to Experience entity
stories.description: As a developer, I need experiences to have an explicit order field so drag-and-drop reordering can be persisted.

stories.title: Add image upload endpoint for blog post headers
stories.description: As the admin, I want to upload an image file for a blog post's header image so I don't have to manage external URLs manually.

stories.title: Add admin API functions and auth utilities to frontend
stories.description: As a developer, I need frontend API helpers that include JWT cookies in requests and cover all admin mutations so admin pages can call the backend securely.

stories.title: Create Next.js middleware to protect admin routes
stories.description: As a developer, I need Next.js middleware that redirects unauthenticated visitors away from /admin/* so the admin panel is never accessible without a valid session.

stories.title: Create admin layout (no public Header/Footer)
stories.description: As the admin, I want a dedicated admin shell with a sidebar so I can navigate between content sections without the public site chrome.

stories.title: Create admin login page
stories.description: As the admin, I want a login page at /admin/login so I can authenticate and access the CMS.

stories.title: Create admin dashboard home page
stories.description: As the admin, I want a simple dashboard landing page so I have a home base after logging in.

stories.title: Create admin About management page
stories.description: As the admin, I want to edit my About section content so my portfolio bio, tech stack, and social links stay current.

stories.title: Create admin Resume management page
stories.description: As the admin, I want to edit my resume data and reorder experiences with drag-and-drop so my CV page stays accurate.

stories.title: Create admin Blog Posts list page
stories.description: As the admin, I want to see all my blog posts in a list so I can manage, edit, or delete them.

stories.title: Create admin Blog Post editor with rich text
stories.description: As the admin, I want a rich text editor for blog posts so I can write formatted content without knowing HTML.

stories.title: Add image upload UI for blog post header images
stories.description: As the admin, I want to upload an image file directly in the post editor so I can set a header image without managing URLs externally.

stories.title: Add drag-and-drop reordering for Technologies
stories.description: As the admin, I want to reorder my technologies list via drag-and-drop so the most relevant skills appear first on my portfolio.
